pricing_method: EMMA description-search -> Official Statement PDF cover (plaintext CUSIPs) -> /Security/Details RTRS trade tape (YX = MSRB yield-to-WORST, sale-to-customer) -> after-tax TEY via build_option_B.tey_aftertax (de-minimis aware, CA top bracket x2.01).
